class.name: SmoothDamp
class.brief_description: Smoothly follows a moving target with a critically damped spring.
class.description:
SmoothDamp eases a value toward a target without overshooting and without the frame-rate dependence of [method @GlobalScope.lerp] used with a constant weight. It is the equivalent of Unity's [code]Mathf.SmoothDamp[/code] and [code]Vector3.SmoothDamp[/code] and is typically used for follow cameras, UI value changes and chasing a moving object. The object keeps the current velocity, so you only pass the current value and the target every frame: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var damper := SmoothDamp.new()
func _ready(): damper.smooth_time = 0.25
func _process(delta): camera.position = damper.step(camera.position, player.position, delta) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] Floats, [Vector2], [Vector3] and [Vector4] are supported. Use one SmoothDamp per value you want to smooth, since each keeps its own velocity.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the stored velocity, so the next [method step] starts from rest. Call it after teleporting the smoothed value.

method.name: step
method.description: Moves [param current] toward [param target] for one frame of duration [param delta] and returns the new value. [param current] and [param target] must be of the same type ([int] is treated as [float]). The result never passes the target. Returns [param current] unchanged if [param delta] is not positive.

method.name: step_angle
method.description: Like [method step] for an angle in radians. The value takes the shortest way around the circle (for example, from [code]350°[/code] to [code]10°[/code] it passes through [code]0°[/code]).

members.member: Maximum speed of the smoothed value, in value units per second. [code]0[/code] means unlimited.
Approximate time in seconds to reach the target. Smaller values follow more tightly. Values below [code]0.0001[/code] are clamped.
The current velocity of the smoothed value, of the same type as the value. Setting it lets you hand over momentum from another movement system.
